Code_CommonName: Tyres — TYRE/TY01-TY04 (parts) vs Tyres (wear item in code)
Detail: Code tracks 'Tyres' as a wear item consumption with quantity data (operations metrics). CSV has TYRE/TY01-TY04 as parts (polymer-rubber archetype, inventory source). Same physical items may appear in both data streams — risk of double-count. No NGA factor for tyre manufacturing embodied emissions — needs PCF (ISO 14067). TY02 (rims), TY03 (tubes), TY04 (accessories) are separate items from tyres proper.
Action: Decide single data source: operations metrics (code) or inventory (parts database). Apply PCF to whichever is authoritative. Remove the other to avoid double-count.

Detail: CSV has LUBR as NGA-Direct Cat 1 (Scope 3 purchased good). Code treats Lubricants as RowType='fuel' with NGA factor 'Petroleum based oils'. This is Scope 1 (combustion/use). The Scope 3 component is well-to-tank, calculated automatically by the code from NGA Scope 3 factors.
Action: Move LUBR to Scope 1 (fuel) in CSV. Scope 3 WTT is already computed by code. If a separate Cat 1 embodied factor is also desired for the lubricant as a purchased product, that needs a PCF — but this would double-count the NGA WTT component.

Detail: NGA Scope 1 and Scope 3 (well-to-tank) factors exist for 'Petroleum based greases'. Code has the Activity/SubActivity mapping but the item is not in the Product_Groups CSV. Emissions can be computed from existing NGA factors.
Action: Confirm code is computing Scope 1 and Scope 3 well-to-tank for greases. Add CSV row as Scope 1 fuel if needed for completeness.

Detail: NGA Scope 1 factor exists for 'Gaseous fossil fuels other than those mentioned above'. No NGA Scope 3 well-to-tank factor published. Code has the Activity/SubActivity mapping. Likely immaterial volume.
Action: Confirm code is computing Scope 1 for acetylene. No Scope 3 well-to-tank factor available in NGA — document as excluded (immaterial, no published factor).

Detail: CSV has PROP as NGA-Direct Cat 1 with method 'Quantity x factor (in-code)'. Code treats LPG as RowType='fuel' with Scope 1 combustion factor. PROP is a Scope 1 fuel, not a Cat 1 purchased good. Scope 3 WTT is computed automatically.
Action: Reclassify PROP as Scope 1 fuel in CSV. Remove from Cat 1.
